description: W. S. Senaratne v. Kasun Jeewantha Ratnayake W. S. Senaratne v. Kasun Jeewantha Ratnayake View More before Hon. Anil Gooneratne, J.
parties: W. S. Senaratne v. Kasun Jeewantha Ratnayake W. S. Senaratne v. Kasun Jeewantha Ratnayake View More
keywords: The Appellant challenged the District Court’s order refusing to set aside an ex parte judgment entered against him. The Appellant claimed that summons had not been served. Evidence from the process server established substituted service. Held - Appellant failed to show valid or reasonable grounds for default under Section 86(2) of the Civil Procedure Code. Appeal dismissed with costs.
legistation: The Constitution of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
